line: Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 (2026, AMD Ryzen AI)
config_name: ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 — Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450, 32GB LPDDR5X, 1TB SSD, 14" WUXGA IPS 400-nit non-touch

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450 (8-core/16-thread: 4 Zen 5 + 4 Zen 5c, up to 5.1 GHz, 40W PL2)
specs.keyboard_notes: ThinkPad keyboard 1.5mm travel, TrackPoint, auto backlit, fingerprint reader

battery.notes: 58Wh. NBC Wi-Fi test at 150 nits: almost 17.5h; 11.5h at max brightness (reviewed same CPU).

price.notes: Verified 2026-11-24: prebuilt model 21YW001KUS promo $2,269 (38% off $3,719 est value), One Year Onsite warranty. Lenovo CA promo max 5 units/order.

reviews.quote: While the performance is only slightly better than before due to improved cooling, you get a lighter chassis and longer battery runtimes.
The speakers were improved as well, so this is a very good overall package, even though the memory is still soldered.

praises: Exact CPU Notebookcheck reviewed — Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450 sustains 25W quietly, fan often off in light work
$2,269 CA promo for 32GB/1TB with vPro-class PRO chip is aggressive vs X1 Carbon pricing
Radeon 860M handles light gaming (GTA V ~25 fps 1080p) plus AVX/encode grunt for the NPU-boosted apps
Fingerprint reader + 5MP IR camera + privacy shutter = Windows Hello works face or finger
One-year onsite warranty on this CA SKU, upgradeable through Lenovo's Premier options
complaints: Still ships with the 45% NTSC 400-nit panel at this price — same washed-out base display complaint
Soldered RAM: 32GB is the practical ceiling for most CA prebuys
60 Hz IPS only; smooth 120 Hz requires jumping to the OLED tier
Standby power draw is high (1.3W measured) — drains battery on shelf between sessions
Wi-Fi 7 module limited to 160 MHz — roughly half the throughput of Intel BE211 rivals

design_philosophy: The volume-seller configuration of the T14s line: PRO-series AMD Ryzen AI silicon with manageability, 32GB/1TB in the sweet spot for knowledge workers, at the price point fleet buyers actually order. It trades the OLED screen for verified all-day battery and the quietest cooling Lenovo has shipped in a T-series s.
rating_notes: Directly matches the CPU of the Notebookcheck-reviewed config (90%); that unit had the better 500-nit sRGB touch panel, so screen_quality/readability are set down for this prebuilt's 45% NTSC panel. 32GB vs reviewed 64GB: productivity −0.5, ai_ml −0.5 (less memory for local LLMs). Battery rating taken directly from NBC's measured runtimes on this CPU.
